analysis.jobDescription: We are looking for a Junior Frontend Developer with strong skills in React, TypeScript and CSS. Experience with REST APIs, Git and responsive design is required. Knowledge of testing (Jest) and accessibility is a plus.

tips.tip: Clear section headings that ATS can parse
Add 'REST API' and 'Jest' keywords from the job description

tips.explanation: Bullet points are short and start with action verbs such as 'Built' and 'Designed'.
The summary uses 'I am'. Resumes read better in implied first person, e.g. 'Frontend developer with…'.
Past roles mix present and past tense. Use past tense for finished work.
The AI Resume Analyzer project directly shows React and API experience.
Add numbers, e.g. 'reduced page load time by 30%' or 'used by 200 students'.
The job lists Jest as a plus; add any unit tests you have written.
One page is ideal for a junior candidate.
Education, Skills, Projects, Experience is a good order for a student.
Some ATS cannot read tables. Use a simple comma-separated list.
React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Git match the job requirements.
The job mentions accessibility; list any ARIA or WCAG experience.
Split into Languages, Frameworks and Tools so recruiters scan faster.

letter.subject: Application for Junior Frontend Developer Position
letter.opening: Discovering the Junior Frontend Developer opening through the Google Careers website immediately captured my professional interest, as my technical background aligns directly with your technological stack. Having built practical competence in modern web development through both professional internship experience and academic projects, I am eager to contribute my capabilities to your engineering team. My hands-on focus centers on building functional, accessible interfaces using standard frontend technologies.
body: During my recent Frontend Intern position at a local software firm, I designed reusable React components for the company's web interfaces and fixed responsive layout bugs so pages display correctly on different screen sizes. In addition to these professional duties, I completed an AI Resume Analyzer project utilizing React, Express, MongoDB, and Tailwind CSS, which incorporated JWT authentication and file uploads. Furthermore, my academic foundation includes a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Engineering from Northern University of Business and Technology Khulna, where I strengthened my technical knowledge. Throughout these practical experiences, I utilized TypeScript, JavaScript, and Git to manage codebases and develop structured web solutions.

Contributing to [Mention something specific about Google] presents a compelling opportunity to apply my technical foundation within a prominent engineering environment. I bring dedicated hands-on proficiency in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, alongside practical exposure to backend integration through Node.js and RESTful concepts. By joining your organization, I aim to apply my technical background to support frontend development tasks while continuing to grow as a software engineer within a collaborative team structure.
letter.closing: I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss how my practical background in frontend development aligns with the requirements of your engineering team. A detailed overview of my qualifications is provided in the attached Europass curriculum vitae for your review. Thank you for your time and consideration of my application, and I look forward to the possibility of an interview.
